ShelfTiltClearanceOutcome

Verified model, not a process simulator

The authored teaching gap is 24 mm above plate 2 and 28 mm above plate 4. The vertical span of a rectangular coupon pitched through angle θ is L sin θ + T cos θ. The simulation uses the maximum over the swept range, plus a fixed vertical hook allowance. Width is bounded by the input definition; lateral collisions are not simulated. The result is a geometric envelope, not friction, a real collision certificate, or a hardware operating limit.

The example uses a 40 × 20 × 2 mm coupon and a 3 mm hook allowance. At 30°, the maximum is 24.732 mm. Plate 2 is short by 0.732 mm; plate 4 leaves 3.268 mm. The export records both attempts against the same unchanged sample. No vacuum, gas, plasma or resist removal is calculated.
